defects.title: Exposed Staging Service-Role Credential Fallback in Source Script
defects.rootCause: Hardcoded Supabase service-role JWT fallback was committed to repository scripts.
remediationActions: Hardcoded fallback secrets permanently eliminated from scripts.
Target host allowlisting enforced: fkpigozcqnmcvofuksar.supabase.co strictly.
Production project ref (ehfafcnimmjusyvplbah) air-gap validation: execution immediately aborts if present.
Write-gating: default mode is DRY-RUN/offline preparation (0 remote mutations); writes require explicit --write flag AND valid CTO authorization token.
Secret redaction: regex scrubbing of service-role keys in all diagnostics, logs, and exceptions.
Automated negative test battery in tests/staging-target-selection-security.test.mjs (10/10 PASS).
defects.externalPrerequisite: External Project Administrator confirmation of JWT secret rotation on Supabase staging dashboard fkpigozcqnmcvofuksar.

defects.title: Caller-Supplied Role Spoofing via user_metadata in userAuth.ts
defects.rootCause: resolveAuthenticatedUser previously consulted user.user_metadata?.role as an alternative role source, allowing caller-supplied metadata to grant privileged roles.
remediationActions: Removed user.user_metadata?.role completely from authorization resolution.
Privileged roles derive ONLY from server-managed user.app_metadata?.role or server-side role lookup.
Unknown or malformed roles fail closed to citizen.
Validated against recognized role set (citizen, moderator, admin, contributor, volunteer, coordinator).
Integration tests added in tests/api-class-b-security-integration.test.mjs (27/27 PASS).

defects.title: Uncontained Test Token Validator Seam in userAuth.ts
defects.rootCause: setTestTokenValidator only checked process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production', allowing registration in any non-production runtime without an active test harness.
remediationActions: setTestTokenValidator requires BOTH process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' AND process.env.TEST_HARNESS_ACTIVE === 'true'.
Throws SECURITY VIOLATION error if called outside an isolated test harness.
resolveAuthenticatedUser enforces both environment guards before invoking the test validator.
Added negative tests proving test harness isolation and adversary role denial.

defects.title: CRIT-C02-02 Political Organizations Catalog Scope Discrepancy
defects.rootCause: Previous reporting conflated 107 canonical organizations with the 1,207 total records across 6 related catalog tables.
remediationActions: Reconciled exact authoritative catalog across 6 tables in Migration 065:
- 107 canonical organizations in political_organizations (100% unique short_name, 0 duplicates)
- 10 organization relationships in organization_relationships
- 27 multilingual names in organization_multilingual_names
- 19 statutory symbols in organization_symbols
- 1,043 aliases in organization_aliases
- 1 dataset provenance record in provenance_records
Total catalog records: exactly 1,207.
Deterministic reconciliation automated in scripts/reconcile_database_criteria_identities.mjs and tested in tests/database-criteria-identity-reconciliation.test.mjs.

Total 2,243 seats across 23 states reconciled.
